Directory listings (not the county) describe ~40 water/electric sites, a few with sewer, pull-thrus, bathhouse, dump station, pool and gold panning, reservations by phone, $16/night + tax (cash/check; undated), open mid-April to December 1. --Claude
summary: No operator presence found: Haralson County's website (its Recreation Department page included) and the City of Tallapoosa's parks page never mention Tally Valley Park or camping; the only description is the n-georgia.com directory (undated, 'Contact for current rates').
